title: Memori
oneLiner: Open-source memory engine for LLM apps and agents that need persistent context injection.
summary: Memori is an open-source memory engine from GibsonAI for giving LLM applications and agents persistent memory, context injection, and configurable recall behavior.
whyItMatters: Memori matters because many agent products need a practical memory engine before they need a full agent framework. It gives teams a focused way to add durable context to conversations and workflows.
bestFor: Developers adding memory to LLM applications

notFor: Users who want a fully managed consumer product with no setup work
Teams that cannot review the linked source, license, and operational requirements before adoption

seoArticle.intro: Memori is an open-source memory engine from GibsonAI for giving LLM applications and agents persistent memory, context injection, and configurable recall behavior.
seoArticle.whatItIs: Memori is an open memory-system resource to evaluate by what it stores, how recall works, how memory is scoped, and whether users or teams can inspect, correct, export, or delete durable context.
seoArticle.whyItMatters: Memori matters because many agent products need a practical memory engine before they need a full agent framework. It gives teams a focused way to add durable context to conversations and workflows.
seoArticle.howItWorks: Test Memori with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.

faq.question: What should I check before using Memori?
faq.answer: Test Memori with repeated sessions. Add facts, update them, ask for recall, inspect retrieval behavior, and verify deletion or scoping controls before storing sensitive user or project memory.
